name: field-final-verification-release
objective: Prove the bounded field scope on one final candidate with automated, backend/database, security, real-device and cross-surface evidence.
truthOwner: Closure is an evidence decision on one exact final candidate, not a historical status field.

tasks.objective: Produce one exact-SHA evidence bundle proving all bounded app-field journeys and dependencies are closed without unresolved blockers.
tasks.currentProblem: No current-BB final evidence exists; historical U009 lacked native and cross-surface proof.
tasks.requiredChange: Run the complete candidate-bound closure matrix, reconcile branch movement and reopen the owning unit for every failure until all required evidence passes.
tasks.targetState: Manifest may move to CLOSED_WITH_EVIDENCE only when all units are DONE on a stable candidate, all required checks pass and real-device/cross-surface evidence is recorded.
tasks.action: Freeze a candidate SHA, run automated/backend/security checks, execute Android and same-store cross-surface scenarios, verify no unrelated scope entered, then re-resolve BB before final result/push.
mustNotChange: Do not close from static inspection.
Do not accept blocked/skipped required checks.
Do not mix evidence from a moved branch without path-impact reconciliation.
Do not import unrelated app work.
acceptanceCriteria: Canonical app-field type/lint/test gates pass and execute real tests.
Branch head is re-resolved and concurrent delta reconciled before final decision.
tasks.rollback: Final verification does not roll back evidence; reopen the owning failed unit and forward-fix the root cause.
tasks.commitBoundary: Final result/closure commit only after every required verification passes on the final candidate.
